title: Morphisms in a left-fraction localization have left-fraction representatives
statement: Let C and D be categories, let W be a class of morphisms of C satisfying the left calculus-of-fractions axioms, and let L : C ⥤ D be a functor that inverts W and has the universal property of the localization at W [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. For objects X,Y of C, every morphism L.obj X ⟶ L.obj Y in D is represented by a left fraction (f : X ⟶ Y', s : Y ⟶ Y') with s in W, via L.map f ≫ inv (L.map s).
